column1: # A bundle names a Java class, not the namespace its functions are registered
# under, and 65 function names repeat across bundles, so the namespace comes from
# this table. A bundle the table does not name is mapped by majority vote of its
# function names against the Effective Catalog; one with no clear majority is left
# out of the index (platform and built-in modules) or kept under its class name
# Format: bundle_class<TAB>namespace, or bundle_class.function<TAB>full name for a
# function that is also registered under a second name.
